functions.name: analyze_document
functions.title: Analyze witness statement
functions.description: Runs AI analysis on an uploaded witness-statement document owned by the signed-in user, extracting persons, relationships, red flags, and flagged passages. Call when the user wants to analyze or re-analyze a document. The document must already exist with an uploaded image; pass its documentId.

documentId.description: ID of the Document record to analyze. Must be owned by the signed-in user.

documentTitle.description: Optional display title; defaults to the document's stored title.

functions.name: ask_sherlock
functions.title: Ask Sherlock about a case
functions.description: Asks the Sherlock AI assistant a question about a case, grounded in provided case context (persons, relationships, red flags). Call when the user wants natural-language reasoning over case data. Returns a concise answer and refuses to fabricate facts not in the context.

question.description: The question to ask, up to 1000 characters.

context.description: Optional case context (JSON of persons/relationships/red flags), up to 20000 characters.

functions.name: detect_contradictions
functions.title: Detect cross-document contradictions
functions.description: Re-runs cross-document contradiction detection across the signed-in user's forensic claims. Compares normalized claims between documents and creates or refreshes Contradiction records (time, location, factual conflicts). Optionally pass documentId to recompute only contradictions touching that one document.

documentId.description: Optional: limit recompute to contradictions touching this document. Omit for a full recompute across all of the user's claims.
